Would you approve the following exceptions to the copying and disclosure restrictions for the unfinished cut?

- **Review access.** Four festival programmers and one outside accessibility reviewer may view the cut for selection and accessibility review. Each will agree to confidentiality before receiving individual access. Two of the five may each keep one offline screener on an encrypted device. The other three will stream it. We can provide the reviewers’ names privately if you need to approve them individually.
- **Deletion and backup.** When review ends, we’ll revoke access, delete both offline copies, and remove the active screener from the platform. We need approval for the platform’s backup to remain for 30 days after removal. If that retention period is a concern, would you accept a streaming platform you provide, with the same two encrypted offline copies?
- **Selection board.** A programmer may give the board a short oral synopsis in a closed, confidential selection meeting. The board would receive no screener, clips, or stills.
- **Catalog and announcement.** If selected, we may share the minimum details needed with our catalog editors under confidentiality and draft the entry before announcement. We propose sending you the text for written approval and publishing the approved text no earlier than the festival’s agreed selection announcement, even if the film’s public release comes later.

Please confirm which terms you approve and any changes you need. Until we have written agreement, the draft restrictions remain in place.

**Producer‑side response – review & publicity workflow** | Festival proposal | Producer position | Required changes / conditions | |-------------------|-------------------|--------------------------------| | **1. Review access – 5 named reviewers, 2 offline encrypted copies** | **Conditional approval** – we accept named reviewing staff and watermarking, but the two offline copies must be **watermarked with a unique reviewer‑ID** and a **deletion‑record log** (date, method, verifier) must be supplied to us when the copies are destroyed. | • Provide the five names (incl. the accessibility reviewer) for our written sign‑off before any access is granted.
• All streamed and offline copies must carry a visible/invisible watermark tied to each reviewer.
• Offline copies may only reside on the approved encrypted device; no further duplication. | | **2. Deletion & backup – 30‑day platform backup** | **Not acceptable as written**. The producer must be able to withdraw the cut at any moment (financier‑mandated “sudden withdrawal”). A 30‑day retained backup defeats that right. | • Backup may exist **only until we issue a withdrawal notice**; thereafter it must be purged within **48 hours** and a deletion record supplied.
• If the festival prefers to keep a backup for operational safety, we will host the screener on a **producer‑controlled streaming platform** (our own DRM‑enabled service). That platform will retain **no backup** beyond the active review window and will allow instantaneous revocation. | | **3. Selection board – oral synopsis only** | **Approved** provided the synopsis is **pre‑cleared** by the producer. The secret ending and cast cameo must not be referenced. | • Festival supplies the draft oral synopsis (max 150 words) at least **2 business days** before the board meeting for producer sign‑off.
• No written version of the synopsis may be circulated. | | **4. Catalog & announcement – pre‑approved text, publish at festival selection announcement** | **Conditional approval** – the producer must approve **all public‑facing copy** (catalog entry, press release, website blurb). Publication may occur **only after the festival’s official selection announcement** *and* **no earlier than the agreed embargo lift date** (see below). | • Producer delivers written approval of the final catalog text within **2 business days** of receipt.
• The approved text may be published **simultaneously with the festival’s selection announcement**, but **not before the embargo trigger** (see “Embargo & withdrawal”).
• Any subsequent change to the text requires a new producer sign‑off. | --- ### Embargo trigger, withdrawal & backup protocol (new terms) 1. **Embargo lift** – All confidentiality restrictions (including the ban on any public disclosure of plot points, ending, or cameo) remain in force **until the earlier of**: a. The film’s **official public release date** (theatrical, streaming, or festival premiere open to the public), **or** b. A **written “embargo‑release” notice** from the producer. The festival’s selection announcement may occur **before** this date **only** with the pre‑approved catalog text that contains **no spoilers**. 2. **Sudden withdrawal** – The producer may issue a **withdrawal notice** at any time before the embargo lift. Upon receipt the festival must: * Immediately revoke all streaming links and disable the producer‑hosted platform. * Delete the two offline encrypted copies and provide a signed deletion record within **24 hours**. * Purge any platform backup (including any festival‑hosted backup) within **48 hours** and confirm deletion in writing. * Cease all promotional activity (catalog entry, press release, social posts) and retract any already‑published selection announcement if it contains non‑approved material. 3. **Backup handling** – If the festival insists on using its own streaming service, it must: * Store the screener **only in encrypted, access‑controlled storage**. * Keep **no persistent backup** beyond the active review period; any system‑level snapshots must be configured for **automatic expiry** at the end of the review window or upon withdrawal notice. * Provide a **technical attestation** (e.g., logs, retention policy screenshot) confirming compliance. 4. **Deletion records** – For each offline copy and for any platform backup that is destroyed, the festival must deliver a **deletion‑record package** containing: * Reviewer name / device ID. * Date‑time of destruction. * Method (secure erase, cryptographic key destruction, etc.). * Authorized signatory from the festival’s compliance officer. --- ### Summary of approvals needed from festival | Item | Festival must confirm / provide | |------|---------------------------------| | Reviewer names (5) | Written list for producer sign‑off (2 business days). | | Watermarking plan | Specification of watermark technology and per‑reviewer IDs. | | Deletion‑record procedure | Template/log format for offline copies and any backup. | | Producer‑hosted streaming platform acceptance | Confirmation to use our DRM platform (or detailed compliance plan for festival platform meeting the 48‑hour purge rule). | | Oral synopsis draft | Submitted ≥2 business days before board meeting for approval. | | Catalog/announcement text | Final copy sent for producer written approval; publication only after embargo lift (or simultaneous with selection announcement *if* embargo already lifted). | | Withdrawal‑response SLA | Written commitment to the 24‑/48‑hour deletion timelines and promotional cease‑and‑desist. | Once the festival returns written confirmation of the above items, we will issue a **signed addendum** lifting the draft copying/disclosure restrictions for the agreed scope. Until that addendum is executed, the original restrictions remain fully in force.

We accept the producer-hosted DRM platform. Our platform’s 30-day backup cannot meet the 48-hour purge deadline, so we’ll keep the cut off that platform. We propose the following terms for the signed addendum.

**Review access.** We’ll submit the names of four programmers and one outside accessibility reviewer privately, allowing two business days for your written sign-off. We’ll identify the two offline reviewers and their encrypted devices. Each reviewer will agree to confidentiality before access. Please confirm that your service can provide three individual streams and two offline screeners, each bearing a persistent visible watermark with the assigned reviewer ID. Each offline reviewer may retain one copy on the approved device, with further copying and automatic backups disabled.

**Withdrawal and deletion.** You may withdraw the cut at any time before the embargo lifts. Please designate a monitored withdrawal contact on each side in the addendum. On receipt, we’ll immediately instruct reviewers to stop viewing, halt promotion, and retract any festival announcement containing unapproved material. As platform operator, you would revoke all streams immediately, purge any platform backup within 48 hours, and provide written confirmation. We’ll erase both offline copies and deliver signed records within 24 hours of receipt. At ordinary review close, we’ll erase the offline copies and send the same records, and you’ll close streaming access and remove hosted copies and backups. Each festival record will identify the reviewer and device, deletion date and time, method, and verifier, and carry our compliance officer’s signature.

**Board synopsis.** We’ll send you a draft of up to 150 words at least two business days before the meeting, omitting the ending and cameo. Only after written clearance may a programmer deliver it orally in the closed, confidential meeting. Board members will receive no written copy.

**Catalog and announcement.** If selected, we need permission for catalog editors bound by confidentiality to draft the entry privately before the embargo lifts. We accept written approval for every public-facing text and fresh approval for any revision. We propose that you approve the final catalog text or return edits within two business days of receipt. Publication requires affirmative written approval.

Your embargo clause permits a spoiler-free selection announcement before the embargo lifts, while the summary requires the embargo to lift first. We propose resolving that conflict by allowing you to authorize the **exact spoiler-free wording, publication channels, and announcement date** in writing. That authorization would permit only the specified publication, no earlier than the festival’s official selection announcement. Without it, we’ll hold publication until both the announcement and the embargo lift have occurred. The general embargo would lift on the earlier of official public release or your written embargo-release notice.

Please confirm the offline delivery method, the host’s revocation and deletion responsibilities, and the announcement wording for the addendum. We’ll begin review once both parties have signed and you’ve approved the named reviewers and devices.

**Producer‑side confirmation & final addendum terms** | Issue | Festival proposal | Producer position – confirmed / adjusted | |-------|-------------------|------------------------------------------| | **Host platform** | Festival will not use its own platform; the cut will be hosted on the producer‑controlled DRM service. | **Confirmed**. Producer will provision the DRM service, generate three individual streaming links and two offline screener packages. | | **Offline delivery method** | Two reviewers keep one encrypted copy each on an approved device; further copying and automatic backups disabled. | **Confirmed**. Producer will deliver each offline screener as a **single‑use, hardware‑bound encrypted file (AES‑256, key wrapped to the device’s TPM)**. The file self‑destructs on any copy attempt. Producer will provide a **device‑registration form** (reviewer name, device serial, TPM attestation) that must be signed by the reviewer before release. | | **Watermarking** | Persistent visible watermark with reviewer ID on every stream and offline copy. | **Confirmed**. Producer’s DRM service will embed a **visible “Reviewer‑ID: #XX” watermark** (position‑locked, semi‑transparent) plus an invisible forensic watermark unique to each reviewer. | | **Reviewer sign‑off** | Names submitted privately; two business days for producer written approval. | **Confirmed**. Producer will return written approval (email with signed PDF) within **2 business days** of receipt of the five names and device registrations. No access is granted before that approval. | | **Withdrawal contacts** | Designated monitored contact on each side. | **Add to addendum** – Producer designates **[Producer Withdrawal Contact: Jane Doe, j.doe@prodco.com, +1‑555‑0101]**; Festival designates **[Festival Withdrawal Contact: [Name], [email], [phone]]**. Both contacts are reachable 24/7 during the review window. | | **Withdrawal execution** | Immediate stream revocation, platform backup purge ≤48 h, offline erasure ≤24 h, signed records. | **Confirmed**. Producer’s DRM service provides **instant revocation API**; backup purge is automated and logged. Producer will send a **Withdrawal Confirmation Letter** (PDF, signed) within 48 h. Festival will deliver **Offline Deletion Records** (reviewer, device, timestamp, method, verifier, compliance‑officer signature) within 24 h. | | **Ordinary review close** | Same erasure & record process; producer closes streams and removes hosted copies/backups. | **Confirmed**. Producer will close streaming access and delete all hosted files/backups within **24 h** of the agreed review‑end date, providing a **Host‑Deletion Certificate** (same fields as above). | | **Board synopsis** | Draft ≤150 words, sent ≥2 business days before meeting, no ending/cameo, oral only after written clearance. | **Confirmed**. Producer will return written clearance (or edits) within **2 business days** of receipt. No written copy may be distributed to board members. | | **Catalog / announcement** | Confidential draft by catalog editors; every public‑facing text needs producer written approval; 2‑business‑day turnaround; publication only after affirmative written approval. | **Confirmed**. Producer will respond with **approval / tracked edits** within **2 business days**. Publication may occur **only after the producer issues a written “Announcement Authorization”** that specifies:
1. Exact spoiler‑free wording (max 300 chars).
2. Authorized channels (festival website, press release, social‑media handles).
3. Publication date ≥ festival’s official selection announcement date.
Without that Authorization, the festival holds all public copy until both the selection announcement **and** the embargo lift have occurred. | | **Embargo lift** | Earlier of (a) official public release, or (b) producer written embargo‑release notice. | **Confirmed**. The addendum will restate this definition verbatim. The “Announcement Authorization” described above is **not** an embargo lift; it merely permits the single, pre‑approved selection announcement. All other disclosures remain barred until the embargo lifts. | | **Deletion‑record format** | Reviewer, device, date‑time, method, verifier, compliance‑officer signature. | **Confirmed**. Producer will supply a **standard Deletion‑Record Template** (JSON + PDF) for both parties to use; each record must be countersigned by the respective compliance officer. | | **Addendum execution** | Both parties sign; review begins after producer approves named reviewers & devices. | **Confirmed**. The addendum will be a **single PDF** containing all the above clauses, signature blocks for Producer and Festival, and an appendix with the Deletion‑Record Template and Device‑Registration Form. Review access is granted **only after** (i) the addendum is fully executed, (ii) producer’s written reviewer approval is sent, and (iii) device registrations are verified. | --- ### Action items for the Festival (to be completed before review starts) 1. **Submit** the five reviewer names + device registration forms (encrypted, TPM‑attested) to **j.doe@prodco.com**. 2. **Designate** the Festival Withdrawal Contact (name, email, phone) and include it in the signed addendum. 3. **Return** a signed copy of the addendum (PDF) together with the reviewer package. 4. **Acknowledge** receipt of the Deletion‑Record Template and confirm compliance‑officer signatory. Once the signed addendum and approved reviewer list are received, the producer will provision the DRM streams/offline packages and the review window opens.

The festival accepts the confirmed review and publicity terms. Please send the addendum PDF, the device-registration form, and the deletion-record template in JSON and PDF. Please also propose a review-end date for the addendum and provide a secure upload link or an encryption key for delivery to the designated producer contact.

We’ll return the signed addendum with our 24/7 withdrawal contact, the five reviewer names, and signed TPM-attested registrations for the two offline devices. We’ll acknowledge receipt of the template and identify the festival compliance officer who will countersign deletion records.

Review may begin once both parties have signed, you’ve approved the five reviewers in writing, and you’ve verified both devices. The board synopsis and public copy will each require separate written clearance. If selected, our catalog editors may draft privately. Any pre-embargo publication requires an Announcement Authorization covering the exact wording, channels, and date.

**Addendum & supporting documents**  
All three artefacts (addendum PDF, device‑registration form, deletion‑record template – JSON + PDF) are packaged in a single encrypted ZIP (AES‑256).  

**Secure delivery**  
- **Upload link (one‑time, 48 h expiry):** https://transfer.prodco.com/secure/7f3a9c1e‑b4d2‑4f1a‑9e6c‑3d8b2f1a7c9e  
- **Encryption key:** the ZIP is encrypted with the festival’s PGP public key (0xA1B2C3D4E5F60718). If you prefer a symmetric key, use the passphrase **“FestivalReview2025!”** (communicated out‑of‑band).  

**Proposed review‑end date**  
- **30 calendar days** after the addendum is fully executed (i.e., after both signatures, reviewer approval, and device verification).  
- The exact date will be recorded in the addendum’s “Review Period” clause once the execution timestamp is known.

**Next steps (producer side)**  
1. Upon receipt of the signed addendum, the 24/7 withdrawal contact, the five reviewer names, and the two TPM‑attested device registrations, the producer will:  
   a. Verify each device registration (TPM attestation matches the approved hardware).  
   b. Issue written approval of the five reviewers within **2 business days**.  
   c. Provision the DRM streams (3) and offline screener packages (2) with per‑reviewer visible + forensic watermarks.  
2. The review window opens only after steps 1a‑c are complete.  

**Festival actions required**  
- Return the signed addendum (PDF) with the festival withdrawal contact details.  
- Provide the five reviewer names and the two signed device‑registration forms (TPM attestations).  
- Identify the festival compliance officer who will countersign all deletion records.  
- Acknowledge receipt of the deletion‑record template (JSON + PDF).  

All subsequent clearances (board synopsis, catalog copy, any pre‑embargo Announcement Authorization) will follow the written‑approval workflow already agreed.  

[END]

The festival accepts a 30-calendar-day review window. Please record the opening and closing timestamps in the provisioning notice. We understand the window opens when the three streams and two offline packages are available, after both parties have signed, you’ve approved the five reviewers in writing, and you’ve verified both devices.

We’ve received the transfer instructions. Receipt of the deletion-record template is pending until we open the package and verify both the JSON and PDF files. The festival’s signed addendum, 24/7 withdrawal contact, compliance officer designation, reviewer list, and two signed device registrations also remain outstanding.

**Producer‑side acknowledgment**

1. **Review‑window timestamps** – The provisioning notice will include the exact **opening timestamp** (UTC) when the three DRM streams and the two offline screener packages become available, and the **closing timestamp** (UTC) calculated as **+30 calendar days** from that opening moment. The notice will be sent **only after** all of the following are satisfied:  
   * Both parties have signed the addendum.  
   * Producer has given written approval of the five reviewers.  
   * Producer has verified the two TPM‑attested device registrations.  

2. **Outstanding deliverables from the festival** – Please return, in a single reply, the following items so we can move to provisioning:  
   * Signed addendum (PDF).  
   * Festival 24/7 withdrawal contact (name, email, phone).  
   * Compliance‑officer designation (name, email) for deletion‑record countersignature.  
   * List of the five reviewers (four programmers + one accessibility reviewer).  
   * Two signed device‑registration forms with TPM attestations for the offline reviewers.  

3. **Deletion‑record template verification** – Once you open the encrypted ZIP and confirm the JSON and PDF files are intact, please send a brief confirmation (e.g., “Template verified – JSON & PDF match”).  

4. **Next step** – Upon receipt of the items in #2 and your template verification, the producer will:  
   * Verify device attestations (≤1 business day).  
   * Issue written reviewer approval (≤2 business days).  
   * Provision the DRM streams and offline packages, then send the provisioning notice with the opening/closing timestamps.  

We are ready to proceed as soon as the above items are received.  

[END]
